title: The Last Bus Home
author: 苏打阅读编辑部
introZh: 错过末班车后，一次意外的帮助让陌生人成为朋友。
paragraphs: Maya reached the bus stop just as the last bus turned the corner. Her phone had no power, and the walk home would take more than an hour. She sat on the bench, wondering what to do. Across the street, Mr. Bell was closing his small bakery.

Mr. Bell noticed Maya and asked if she needed help. When she explained her situation, he offered to let her charge her phone inside. While they waited, he showed her an old photograph of the bakery. Maya recognized the man beside Mr. Bell in the picture. It was her grandfather, who had once delivered flour to the shop.

The discovery changed their quiet wait into a long conversation. When Maya's phone finally turned on, she called her brother and arranged a ride home. Before leaving, she promised to visit the bakery again. The next Saturday, she arrived with an old recipe book that had belonged to her grandfather.
